notes: CONVERT_TO_USD (nme-margin-calculation.sas) converts foreign-currency sale adjustments (e.g. freight, brokerage) to U.S. dollars using each sale's own daily exchange rate, dynamically building the list of _USD output variable names via %SCAN/%DO %UNTIL. Reproduced verbatim, called the same way the repo calls it. Mock 5-row USSALES dataset carries per-row EXRATE_DAILY, FREIGHT, and BROKERAGE; conversion arithmetic verified by hand (FREIGHT_USD = FREIGHT * EXRATE_DAILY for every row) and DROP=&VARS_TO_USD confirmed to remove the original foreign-currency columns.
